### Master's in {{< meta academic.mqef >}} {#mqef}
University of Luxembourg

Very Good Pass (A) · GPA 17/20 · Thesis grade 20/20 (A+).

Thesis · [On Partial-Sum Processes of ARMAX Residuals: ARMA with Polynomial Time Trends and Unit Roots](../research/projects/armax-residual-partial-sums.qmd).

Supervised by Prof. Benjamin Holcblat and Prof. Steffen Grønneberg.

Selected coursework includes advanced econometrics, advanced microeconomics, advanced macroeconomics, advanced financial theory, general equilibrium theory and empirical analysis.
